description: Google Keep notes. The Keep API cannot edit a note; create a new one and delete the old one instead. Actions: create_note(title?, text?, items?) where items is a checklist like [{"text":"Milk","checked":false}]. Destructive (confirm:true): delete_note(note) with note as notes/<id>.

params.description: Action parameters; destructive actions also need confirm: true

name: keep_admin
